# Jamia Siddhiqe Akbar Ahale Sunnat Trust

> A madrasa in Nashik, Maharashtra, India, opened in 2024. It teaches Quran, Hifz, Tajweed, Dars-e-Nizami (the eight-year Aalim course), Hadith, Fiqh, with an Aalimah course for girls coming soon, at low fees funded by donations. Also known as Siddique Akbar Trust, Jamia Siddique Akbar, or Jamia Siddique Akbar Ahle Sunnat Trust. Bank account name: Jamia Siddhiqe Akbar Ahale Sunnat Trust. The site is in English, Urdu (/ur) and Hindi (/hi).

- Address: Ashrafi Chowk, Sanjiv Nagar, Link Road, Nashik, Maharashtra
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 8055108635
- Email: info@siddiqueakbartrust.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Registered under 80G and 12A: donations from Indian taxpayers are tax-deductible
- Students: 150+ · Teachers: 5+ (all hold ijazah) · Separate department for girls with women teachers: coming soon

## Pages

- [About](https://www.siddiqueakbartrust.com/about): history, mission and values
- [Our institution](https://www.siddiqueakbartrust.com/our-institution): courses, campus, timeline and FAQs
- [Admissions](https://www.siddiqueakbartrust.com/admission): how to apply
- [Donate](https://www.siddiqueakbartrust.com/donation): Zakat, Sadaqah and Waqf by UPI or bank transfer
- [Gallery](https://www.siddiqueakbartrust.com/gallery): photos and past gatherings
- [Contact](https://www.siddiqueakbartrust.com/contact): phone, WhatsApp, address and hours

## Common questions

- Who can enrol? Children, young people and adults. Boys are admitted now; a separate department for girls is opening soon.
- What courses are taught? Hifz-ul-Quran, Tajweed, Dars-e-Nizami (eight-year Aalim course), Hadith, Fiqh, Islamic studies, and Urdu, Arabic and English.
- How do I apply? Fill in the form at https://www.siddiqueakbartrust.com/admission or WhatsApp +91 8055108635.
- How do I donate? UPI ID jamiasiddhiqe@srcb, or bank transfer to Saraswat Co-Operative Bank, account 610000000072389, IFSC SRCB0000493. Send name, PAN and amount on WhatsApp for an 80G receipt.
